scope_note: Covers whether the Social Security (Amendment) (Scotland) Act 2025 is in force, which provisions are commenced, and by which instruments. Covers the commencement instruments made under the Act. Limited to legislation.

steps.title: Confirm the Act exists and retrieve it
steps.detail: Find the Social Security (Amendment) (Scotland) Act 2025 by title and by its citation 2025 asp 2, and confirm which identifier holds it.

steps.title: Read the Act's commencement provision
steps.detail: Retrieve the commencement section and record which provisions come into force on Royal Assent, which are left to regulations, and whether regulations may make different provision for different purposes.

steps.title: Find the commencement instruments
steps.detail: Search for commencement regulations made under the Act, and retrieve each one found, recording which sections it commences and from what date.

steps.title: Report the position provision by provision
steps.detail: Set out which sections are in force and when, which remain uncommenced, and state the date the answer speaks as at, rather than giving a single yes or no.
